description: SenseNova input-image resize cases shared by the server's KV-token prediction (crates/server/src/profile/mod.rs) and the worker's image preparation (tests/python/unit/execution/test_image_input.py). Each case gives a source size in pixels and the number of input images in its request; the request's input images share a 4096x4096 pixel budget, so each image's pixel bound is min(2048 * 2048, 4096 * 4096 // input_images), as in the reference preprocessing. Expected values follow the reference resize (vllm-omni _smart_resize at a 32-pixel factor with a 512 * 512 lower bound): the resized size in pixels and its KV tokens, one per 32x32 pixel block.
